page.layout: One page of text, single column, centred on the scan; running head at top with page number at left; faint show-through text from the facing page in the right margin, not transcribed.

main_text.p: tussis, sputum, & his quæ-cumque, aut paria, aut etiam minora, omnia sunt perpetuum artificium, omnia affectata, studio compósita, germanum nihil: Patria hujus Genii, plumariorum & Phrygionum tabernæ: Educatus est in mulierum gynæceis, inter puparum mundos, inter nundinarum crepundia, inter conchyliata aulæa, inter belluata tapetia, inter cælaminum pampinos & thyrsos, inter Corinthiorum operum crobylos & corimbos; &, si quæ his similia, in quibus Artis libidine penitus deflorata Natura est. Cum tetuamque supellectilem con-tem-
main_text.notes: Running head reads "ARNOLDI GEULINCX," with the comma as printed. The last word of the page, "tem-", is set at the right and continues on the next page. Line-initial "tuffis" reads "tussis" in the printed text; transcribed as printed in the scan's spelling, "tussis" is taken as the printer's form. Some words in the centre are rendered slightly faintly ("compósita" printed "compofita"); transcribed as the probable letters.
